class Bad:
    n: int

def check(x: int) -> int fail Bad:
    """Succeeds with x when x is even, otherwise fails with Bad(n=x)."""
    ex check(2) == Ok(2)
    ex check(3) == Err(Bad(n=3))
    if x % 2 == 1:
        fail Bad(n=x)
    return x

def all_even(xs: list[int]) -> list[int] fail Bad:
    """Checks every element of xs in parallel and returns them unchanged when all are even.
    If any element is odd, fails with the Bad of the lowest-index odd element,
    regardless of which thread finishes first."""
    post out.len() == xs.len()
    ex all_even([]) == Ok([])
    ex all_even([2, 4, 6]) == Ok([2, 4, 6])
    ex all_even([2, 3, 4]) == Err(Bad(n=3))
    ex all_even([5, 2, 7]) == Err(Bad(n=5))
    ex all_even([4, 9, 1, 6]) == Err(Bad(n=9))
    results = par [check(x)? for x in xs]
    return results
